# Jubilees Chapter 20 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Abraham Gathers His Sons for Final Instructions

---

**20:1** In the forty-second jubilee — the first year of the seventh week — Abraham called together all his sons: Ishmael and his twelve boys, Isaac and his two sons, and the six sons he had with Keturah, along with their children.

**20:2** He charged them all: live by the LORD's way. Do what is right. Love each other. Treat all people with justice and integrity — let that be how you walk through this world.

**20:3** Circumcise your sons, as the covenant requires. Don't wander from the path the LORD has laid out for you — not to the right, not to the left.

**20:4** Do not take wives from the Canaanites. Canaan's line is destined to be uprooted from this land entirely.

**20:5** Then Abraham reminded them what happened to the giants in the ancient days, and what happened to Sodom — how those cities were judged and destroyed because of their wickedness, their sexual depravity, their filth, and the corruption they had sunk into together.

**20:6** "Stay away from all sexual immorality and filth, and everything that pollutes the soul through sin. If you don't, our very name will become a curse. Your lives will become a byword for shame. Your sons will fall by the sword. You'll end up like Sodom — wiped out, every last one of you."

**20:7** "That's what sexual immorality, impurity, and idol-worship did to them. It destroyed them and made them an object of contempt forever."

**20:8** "So I'm making you swear — and this is the greatest oath there is — by the name of God, that name which is glorious, honored, great, magnificent, wonderful, and mighty: swear that you will not fear any human being, but will worship only the LORD your God, who made heaven and earth and everything in them.

**20:9** Live rightly in everything you do. Walk straight. Don't let the impure spirits drag you off course — they are always trying to lead you away from God."

**20:10** That same day Abraham divided up his estate between Ishmael and Isaac. Isaac received the larger share. Ishmael and his sons and Keturah's sons received their portions directly from Abraham's hand.

**20:11** Abraham gave generous gifts to Ishmael and his sons and to Keturah's sons, then sent them east — away from Isaac — to make their lives in the eastern lands.

**20:12** Everything else — all his remaining wealth — he gave to Isaac alone.

---
*PNEUMA notes: "Fornication/sexual immorality" — zemmut covers boundary-crossing sexual sin broadly. The Sodom reference here is primarily about sexual ethics and idolatry together, not hospitality violation. Abraham's estate division foreshadows Israel's exclusive claim to the land.*
